title: Lower admitted-stencil CRT guard scan to a literal three-tape program
body:
This lowers the dense guard scan already proposed in PR4100 to an explicit three-tape finite-control program. Given an **admitted ordered finite-alphabet stencil**, it enumerates all `M=2^L` addresses, writes an owned BAD mask, preserves the stencil, blanks private counter data/right marker and returns every head. The written proof derives exactly `8ML+15M+13L+18` cell/head actions and `M+2L+6` visited cells. Finite alphabet/control gives a constant-factor bit-machine lowering. `O(ML)=O(V)` uses the source’s `L=Theta(p), R=Theta(p), V=MR` premises.

**The geometry/threshold/stencil producer and admission path are unpriced host adapters.** This is the detector from a supplied stencil, with no E callback. It does not price exception extraction, inverse keys, sorting, payload routing, reinsertion, ordinary callees, full E/CRT, precision/native/outer composition or a new κ.

Validation: eight normal/optimized registered checks pass. Primary executes6,525,207 literal actions over49,408 complete source-bound addresses, plus all-SKIP small-counter cases. A separate preimplementation oracle covers49,152 addresses/196,608 parity and spectator toggles/12 boundaries. A pinned comparison checks all49,408 masks plus181 generic stencils/1,300 addresses; a separate cost checker covers14 cases/2,058 addresses and detects an underbilled READ without changing output or ownership. Real mutants detect wrong thresholds/significance, unadjusted full-K guard tests, a skipped counter bit and omitted owned-output return. All three canonical source inputs stay unchanged. Finite evidence corroborates the quantified proof; it is not full caller acceptance.

Reproduce with Python3.12/standard library: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-dense-guard-scan`. Exact scope, source pins, conditional input contract and next questions are retained in TASK.json, PROOF.md and EVIDENCE.md. Smallest follow-up: construct and admit the ordered stencil at the transported source caller with every producer/consumer step charged.

Task `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined scope `0593fcf1b94f3cd8f1be`, priority7, canonical base/current main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`. Before submission, complete pagination covered316 open/draft PR bodies plus current hub/4173 and focused dense-guard Discussion search; broader code/closed/Discussion coverage is partial. PR4197’s staged-word forests, PR4198’s Stein producer and PR4200’s BIT COPY floor address distinct obligations.

Credit: Cinna Davis already supplies the predicate and ordered-scan proposal in CRT.md238–253; Hiroki KUMAZAKI (@kumagi), PR4169 at835c3563ee7ede8ceaf329ede7372e50f7823136 and PR4174 at5fec853f0c048871de3b8098d1e30d4ee19cda23, supplies repair and placement/descriptor work with scan tariffs left open. Douglas Colkitt/OpenAI framework and complete retained source NOTICE lineage are preserved. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate-agent semantic and cost review; no independent human/formal-kernel acceptance. Apache-2.0. No merge/frontier change; maintainer edits disabled.

Exact published head `4f49743a9df0cf7501cdc62bd5707a122fa071e9` passed the24-file committed-byte/source-history preflight and all eight checks from a Git-free export of the committed bytes. All exported package/input bytes stayed unchanged.
